full_judgment: 11. The High Court Division may also pass any directions or any such functionaries to refrain from doing that which he is not permitted by law to do or to do that which he is required by law to do. In this connection the respondent Nos. 1-3 are not permitted under the law to transfer or sell out the property of the petitioner which is a debuttar property in favour of the third party namely, the respondent No.4 Bangladesh Mukhti Joddha Kallyan Trust and, as such, the transfer may be declared to have been done without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect.' Furthermore, the Notification dated 13th July, 1968 by which the Hardeo Glass, Aluminium, Enamel and Silicate Works, 4 Hatkhola Road, Dhaka and other properties and assets, moveable or immoveable including any right, title and interest accrued or likely to accrue under a contract or otherwise, vested in or belonging to, or held or managed by or on behalf of, the said enemy rum and all monies payable to, or for the benefit of, said enemy firm, being enemy properties have been vested in the Additional Custodian of Enemy Property in East -Pakistan. In this notification although there is no clear arid specific mention of property (by mentioning the dag and khatian number thereto being treated as an enemy property) but the same is stated to have been vested in the government. The respondent Nos. 1-3 are' not empowered to sell out the property of the petitioner which is admittedly a debuttar property. At best the property of the'M/s Hardeo Glass Aluminium Enamel and Silicate Works whose owner migrated to India, their business and property could be treated as an enemy property. The aforesaid transfer by way of a deed of sale by the respondent Nos. 1-3 is highly illegal as such, the same is liable to be declared to have been executed and registered illegally and without any lawful authority as such the impugned sale dated 9-11-89 executed and registered by respondent Nos. 1-3 in favour of the respondent No. 4 Bangladesh Mukhti Joddha Kallyan Trust is hereby declared to have been done without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect so far it relates to the property of deed of Endowment dated 25-9-1903.
